CustomField.description:
Indicates whether the applicant fails residency eligibility requirements based on grade applying to.
Pre-K: Mailing City must be New York
K–12: Mailing State must be NY Used to block eligibility decisions and drive review UI.
CustomField.formula:
OR(
/* Pre-K rule violation: address is not within NYC */ AND( ISPICKVAL(Grade_Applying_To__c, "PK"),
NOT( OR( LEFT(Account.PersonMailingPostalCode, 3) = "100", LEFT(Account.PersonMailingPostalCode, 3) = "101", LEFT(Account.PersonMailingPostalCode, 3) = "102",
LEFT(Account.PersonMailingPostalCode, 3) = "103",
LEFT(Account.PersonMailingPostalCode, 3) = "104",
LEFT(Account.PersonMailingPostalCode, 3) = "111",
LEFT(Account.PersonMailingPostalCode, 3) = "112",
LEFT(Account.PersonMailingPostalCode, 3) = "113",
LEFT(Account.PersonMailingPostalCode, 3) = "114",
LEFT(Account.PersonMailingPostalCode, 3) = "116",
LEFT(Account.PersonMailingPostalCode, 5) = "11004", LEFT(Account.PersonMailingPostalCode, 5) = "11005" ) ) ),
/* K-12 rule violation: address is outside New York State */ AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Grade_Applying_To__c, "PK")), UPPER(Account.PersonMailingState) <> "NY" ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatically flags when residency requirements are not met based on grade applying to. Pre-K applicants must have a Mailing City of “New York”. K–12 applicants must have a Mailing State of “NY”.
CustomField.label: Residency Restriction
